skill.keys.readabilityNote: 3px micro-labels fit the only non-overlapping gap in the supplied coordinate bands.

map.advance: map glyph width; all marker additions must have net advance zero

players.playerCenterDelta: other tile coordinate minus own tile coordinate
players.xPlacement: move cursor to map-center-relative x-4; emit 8 pixels; rewind 8 after each row
players.ownHead: center at (0,0), same skin pixel order

scrollColor.shaderDecode: dx = r - 128; dy = g - 128; each encoded delta is clipped to signed 7-bit range [-64, 63]
scrollColor.mapTransform: screenCenter=(screenWidth-36,36); map glyph itself is centered at bossbar title center=(screenWidth/2,12); shader translates by (screenWidth/2-36-dx,24-dy) GUI px

notes.coordinateOrigin: bottom-center GUI px; x right+, y up+
notes.ascentFormula: For target bottom-origin top Y: ascent = Y - 65. Vanilla actionbar drawString baseline gives text top at screenHeight-72; BitmapProvider ink top = drawY + (7-ascent).
notes.actionbarOrigin: centered; append -sum(advances) space to place cursor at x=0
notes.bitmapAdvance: 1.21.11 rounded ink width + 1; emitted advance = rightmost nontransparent pixel + 1
notes.contextualOverlayCaveat: Coordinates assume default/no contextual left-right GUI overlays; vanilla actionbar y shifts when those overlays occupy more height.

renderSequence.restoreTitleCursor: append spaces whose total is -(backdrop.advance-8), then vanilla title
renderSequence.titlePlate: render gui.title at x=40 with y offset +2 relative to vanilla title baseline, then its caption
renderSequence.spaces: compose non-power-of-two advances from hud-glyphs.json spacing entries

gui.layering: Backdrop interior is transparent; only thin frame and slot rules plus the title plaque are opaque/semitransparent. Verify on an actual container because title glyphs are rendered over slots.

mapGlyph.name: minimap.map.<plaza|highland|field|dungeon|arena>
order: map glyph first; then player pixel/direction glyphs with zero-net advance
mapGlyph.hiddenWithoutShader: PNG alpha 1/255; vanilla rendertype_text discards alpha < 0.1

scrollColor.shaderDecode: dx = r - 128; dy = g - 128; each encoded delta is clipped to signed 7-bit range [-64, 63]
scrollColor.mapTransform: screenCenter=(screenWidth-36,36); map glyph itself is centered at bossbar title center=(screenWidth/2,12); shader translates by (screenWidth/2-36-dx,24-dy) GUI px

skinPixels.name: minimap.head.pixel.<00-63>
skinPixels.order: row-major y*8+x; each 1x1 glyph is tinted by the original skin pixel RGB
skinPixels.yPosition: font offset = target pixel Y relative to marker center; x is placed with space glyphs
skinPixels.self: same 8x8 pixels at delta (0,0), centered over the viewport center
